01_home_dark.note: Home digest, dark. Static layout; exact match expected.

02_home_light.note: Home digest, light. Same layout as 01 in the light palette.

03_transcript_dark.note: Transcript with three tabs open, dark.

04_transcript_light.note: Transcript with three tabs open, light.

05_transcript_t6_dark.note: Transcript with t6 (a running thread, 3 sub-agents) active.

06_hover_row_star_dark.note: A hovered unstarred chat row revealing its hollow star. Was unbaselined as a duplicate of 01_home_dark; the row is rendered now and the two differ over the star's 12x11 box.

07_hover_tab_dark.note: A non-active content tab in its hover state.

07b_hover_msg_copy_dark.note: A hovered message with its Copy bar. Baselineable only because the capture epoch is pinned: the bar prints an absolute clock time, which used to move every minute.

10_view_starred_dark.note: Starred smart view, with the state chips.

10b_view_pinned_row_dark.note: Pinned smart view populated with a running session; holds the shared smart-view card structure.

11b_view_archived_row_dark.note: Archived smart view populated with a settled session; holds the shared smart-view card structure.

12_view_blocked_light.note: Blocked-on-you smart view in the light palette.

13_chat_welcome_dark.note: Chat with no thread open: the welcome prompts.

13b_empty_transcript_dark.note: An open conversation with no messages; the empty state is anchored above the composer.

14_sidebar_folded_dark.note: Sidebar folded to the icon rail.

15_settings_dark.note: Settings overlay, dark. Every preference control on one sheet.

17_newtask_dark.note: New-task overlay with an empty field.

18_auth_dark.note: Device-code sign-in. The code and URL are the mock's fixed example.invalid pair.

19_many_tabs_dark.note: Ten open tabs: the strip shrinks to fit.

20_big_transcript_dark.note: The rbig perf fixture. Baselineable only because the capture epoch is pinned: a date divider used to sweep into the visible tail as local midnight passed through the fixture.

21_tools_expanded_dark.note: Every tool pile and the sub-agent rollup pre-expanded.

23_skeleton_dark.note: The list skeleton, before any session arrives.

24_thread_loading_dark.note: A thread's loading state. Was unbaselined as a duplicate of 03_transcript_dark; the loading state survives to the settle frames now and the two differ over the transcript body.

25_load_older_dark.note: The load-older affordance at the top of a transcript.

26_thinking_dark.note: The live thinking indicator. The timer reads a fixed number because the capture clock is frozen (src/util/capture_clock.h).

28_composer_focus_dark.note: Composer focused: caret and focus ring. Was byte-identical to 03_transcript_dark until the capture hook learned to arm :focus-visible (src/ui/focus_visible.h keeps the ring off until Tab is pressed, and a headless capture presses nothing).

29_find_dark.note: Find in conversation with matches highlighted.

31_selection_dark.note: A run of transcript text selected.

32_new_messages_dark.note: Reopening a thread that gained messages while you were away. Same pinned-epoch dependency as 20_big_transcript_dark.
